items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sure enough, he got Lockjaw – Eddie "Lockjaw" Davis – to play How High the Moon about one hundred miles an hour

ctx.x: There might have been. I can't remember.

I think it was the Blue Note or something like that in Philadelphia that was a prominent venue on the jazz circuit. When you toured playing jazz, you would inevitably play at that club. One of the most interesting experiences I ever had at this club was I came through Philadelphia touring with my own group – quintet, quartet or whatever the case might have been. Miles was appearing at this club, and it was exciting, as you would expect. Lockjaw was in the audience. I had never heard Lockjaw play. I knew about…
